title: Allow Pillow 13 (raise upper bound to <14)
body:
### Checklist

- [x] I have searched the [existing issues](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues) for similar feature requests.
- [x] I added a descriptive title and summary to this issue.

### Summary

Raise the Pillow cap in `lib/pyproject.toml` from `<13` to `<14`.

### Why?

[Pillow 13.0.0](https://pillow.readthedocs.io/en/stable/releasenotes/13.0.0.html) fixes two critical and about a dozen high-severity CVEs. Projects that depend on Streamlit can't upgrade while the cap is `<13`.

### How?

```diff
-  "pillow>=9.2.0,<13",
+  "pillow>=9.2.0,<14",
```

Then regenerate `uv.lock`. Streamlit doesn't use any of the APIs that 13.0 removed, and the one `fromarray` call doesn't pass `mode`.

One behavior change: `st.image` with an `I`-mode `PIL.Image` and `output_format="PNG"` now raises instead of silently clipping.

### Additional Context

#14881 and #15782 raised the lower bound but left the `<13` cap.
